Purpose: Physical read-only characterization of public NVML observability around externally-applied GPU locked-clock states.

Interpretation.ApplicationGraphicsClockTarget: The export exists but the call returned NVML error 3 in all four captures, so this target does not provide the application-clock target as a usable ownership signal.
Interpretation.CurrentClocksEventReasons: Value 36 was identical in baseline, AC lock, Battery lock and reset states; it is non-discriminating for locked-range ownership on this target.
Interpretation.CurrentGraphicsClock: Observed values changed across captures (2010, 1260, 1200, 1125 MHz) and therefore reflect instantaneous operating conditions rather than exact requested locked range.
Interpretation.ExactLockedRange: No exact public-NVML min/max readback was available in any capture.

ProductDecision.Reason: Public NVML cannot prove exact locked-clock range ownership on the qualified target. Implementing external-writer detection, automatic reacquire, or conditional reset would be unsafe.
